offers_products.reason: Sells claims management services; Care360 platform supports services, not sold as standalone product.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Clients are employers, insurance carriers, and government bodies buying claims and risk management programs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing claims administration and managed care programs for repeat clients with continuing multi-year relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Claims handling and injury care for workers' comp and liability claims continue regardless of the economy.

big_ticket.reason: Claims services are billed per claim or program on an ongoing basis, in small frequent amounts.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from claims adjusters, nurses, and return-to-work coordinators, though technology platform supports them.

large_customers.reason: Customers include large employers like Texas Roadhouse, Cheesecake Factory, insurance carriers, and government authorities.

asset_heavy.reason: Claims management and nurse services need staff and software, not plants, fleets or property.
